shared_tail.surface: عبد الحميد بن عبد الرحمن، بن زيد
محمد بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: two taḥwīl branches converge at the father of Ya'qub (the second branch's «حدثنا أبي»); the names written once after that meeting, from «عن صالح» to Sa'd, form the shared tail (rule 3)
«- وهو ابن إبراهيم بن سعد -» and «- يعني ابن سعد -» are editor glosses and are left out; «إبراهيم» in the first branch is the first occurrence
Umar speaks inside the story («قال عمر»), but the saying's transmitter is Sa'd, who relays the Prophet's words; so Sa'd is the last link
«أن أباه سعدا» — the father is named by relation only; the link is the name alone (rule 7)
